teaching: The command targets git.drupalcode.org via the --repo flag (the hostname is in the repo path). glab resolves the Drupal.org token automatically — no GITLAB_HOST env var, no manual token extraction, and no change to any global default host.
prompt: I'm working on a Drupal contrib module hosted on git.drupalcode.org. Show me the glab command to list the open issues for the project 'token'.
response:
Here's the command:

```bash
glab issue list --repo "git.drupalcode.org/project/token"
```

This lists open issues (work items) by default. A few useful additions:

- `glab issue view <id> --repo "git.drupalcode.org/project/token"` — view a specific issue
- `--web` — open the result in your browser
- `-o json` — JSON output for scripting

One caveat: `token` is an older, well-established module, so if this returns nothing on an obviously active project, it may still be on Drupal's legacy issue queue (which `glab` can't see). In that case the issues live at `www.drupal.org/project/token/issues`.
